title: After a restart the job status record freezes at 5% "running" although the job finishes its writes; first cancel is a silent no-op; history records a completed job as cancelled/0 rows

root_cause: Fencing accepted only an equal token, and fences restarted from 1 after a release or a process restart, so a reclaimed run's status writes were refused as stale and the record froze at the dead worker's 5%. The cancel endpoint returned cancelled even when that fenced write was refused.
fixed_or_not: fixed in code, unit-proven (test_a_newer_fence_supersedes_the_dead_workers_fence, test_acquire_never_hands_out_a_fence_below_the_jobs, test_operator_cancel_is_not_fenced, test_a_job_waiting_for_a_pool_thread_keeps_its_lease). A stored fence at or below the writer's is accepted and only a lower fence is stale; acquire seeds above the job's recorded fence; operator cancel is an unfenced control write and the endpoint returns the real status when nothing was recorded. The lease heartbeat starts at submit, not when a pool thread picks the job up. Not a live restart retest.

notes: Priority conflict: QA-B P1, OPEN-DEFECTS 21:15 table P2 (QA-B latest report used).
root_cause: BSON date keeps milliseconds. DATETIME(6) / DATETIME2(7) / TIMESTAMP(6) were judged on declaration alone, so every create-new from MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server and Oracle blocked even for whole-second data. Declaring a zone rewrote the column to a bare TIMESTAMPTZ, which read as no precision, and the writer then truncated microseconds silently; a TIMESTAMPTZ(6) target echoed from the source missed the writer's temporal branch and landed as a string. Gate-8 had no rows because the copilot sampler's failure was logged and dropped and the plan refetch swallowed its exception.
fixed_or_not: fixed in code, unit-proven (test_whole_millisecond_population_is_not_a_collapse, test_unmeasured_sub_millisecond_column_stays_a_truncation, test_declared_zone_keeps_the_columns_precision, test_writer_quarantines_a_microsecond_cell_and_writes_the_rest, test_live_mongo_round_trip_keeps_milliseconds_and_refuses_microseconds, test_gate8_proves_on_the_engine_sample_when_none_was_posted, test_gate8_names_the_read_failure, test_mongo_create_new_blocks_a_measured_microsecond_before_the_write). A measured population of whole milliseconds is not a collapse; finer or unmeasured stays one; the writer refuses a sub-millisecond cell unless the risk is accepted and reports accepted truncation. Validate reads its own sample through the Execute reader and names a failed read on Gate-8. A zoneless source still needs its zone declared (assume_timezone). Live proof is a local standalone mongod round-trip only; not a live MySQL/SQL Server/Oracle to MongoDB retest.

title: ASCII Excel load into an existing SQL Server Latin-1 VARCHAR is blocked, and signing cast-and-continue is ignored; the plan still says lossless
exact_error: Blocked on zip_code and sku (ASCII only). Signing cast-and-continue or quarantine is ignored. Plan conversion_class is lossless.
notes: The 9:48 AM deploy stopped silent question-mark substitution and then blocked every load into a Latin-1 VARCHAR, including plain ASCII.
root_cause: code_page_sink_would_collapse was a type-level fact with no population. Excel is a Unicode source, so every text column into a SQL Server code-page VARCHAR was a fidelity collapse even when every sample encoded. Map stamped lossless when the file format was not bound as the source engine. findings_from_coercion_report kept blocking true whenever fidelity_collapse was true, so a signed CAST_AND_CONTINUE that had softened severity to warn was still a block.
fixed_or_not: fixed in code, unit-proven (test_ascii_excel_into_sql_latin1_varchar_is_not_a_collapse, test_signed_cast_clears_the_code_page_block, test_unicode_source_into_sql_latin1_varchar_is_a_fidelity_collapse). A measured population that encodes in the destination code page is not a collapse, and the plan conversion_class is lossless. An unmeasured pair stays a collapse. A scalar outside the page stays a collapse and the writer still refuses question-mark substitution. A verified CAST_AND_CONTINUE sets severity warn and the finding is not blocking. Not a live SQL Server retest.
